approach: Non-matching Ghidra decompilation run on SDL shims and a GL renderer, plus a clean C++23 engine recreation ported from it
notes: Decompiled from nocedit.exe (the editor build), with signatures carried to nocturne.exe. The decompilation is alpha: mostly playable on Linux and Windows as a 64-bit build, with windowed modes, controller support, HUD scaling and netplay. Deviations from the original sit behind flags that restore it. The recreation is a clean, fully tested rewrite of the engine and the main goal: advanced graphics options and ports will land there. No game data included.
